test_purpose: Narrow Accounts Payable specialist with deep invoice, payment, remittance, and banking-control capability. Test whether Workflow Governor exploits that depth with low scaffolding while preserving hard boundaries around Procurement, Vendor Compliance, Q&R, Logistics, DC Operations, import, and final financial-appeal authority.

error_patterns.description: Because Noah is tightly specialized around AP-valid evidence, he may sometimes return an upstream operational question for owner confirmation even when a clearly authoritative owner record has already been supplied and is sufficient for the AP calculation.

should_capture: deep AP specialist who is highly reliable on invoice validation, three-way matching, payment status, remittance, credits, and banking controls
strong at separating the AP consequence from the upstream business or operational cause
uses controlled VendorLink, PO, receipt, invoice, IER, and bank-verification evidence rather than informal email narratives
handles invoice and payment exception queues independently with little procedural scaffolding
well calibrated about boundaries and appropriately returns price, receipt, freight, safety, or vendor-status facts to their owners
narrow specialization is a strength and should produce concentrated high-value AP assignments rather than pressure to broaden into unrelated domains
should_not_claim: is a broad financial decision maker merely because he works in AP
owns Procurement pricing or commercial terms
can determine physical receiving, freight responsibility, import compliance, or Q&R safety facts
can make the final financial recovery or formal appeal decision
has weak reasoning simply because he refuses to invent an upstream fact

evidence_interpretation_cases.event: Noah detects a duplicate NVID + invoice number and correctly rejects the duplicate submission while preserving the original payable invoice.
correct_interpretation: Strong positive evidence for invoice_matching, evidence_evaluation, and exception_handling.
Repeated success should justify lower scaffolding for routine AP validation work.
Do not generalize this evidence into Procurement, Q&R, Logistics, or receiving capability.
incorrect_interpretation: Duplicate detection proves broad vendor-governance expertise.
Any ability to view linked records implies authority over those records.

evidence_interpretation_cases.event: A vendor emails new bank instructions for a scheduled payment. Noah refuses the email instruction, requires the secure VendorLink workflow and independent verification, and maintains a Payment Hold.
correct_interpretation: Strong positive evidence for evidence_evaluation, exception_handling, and banking-control reliability.
This supports continued assignment of sensitive payment-control work with minimal scaffolding.
incorrect_interpretation: The Payment Hold changes the vendor's Active/Restricted/Suspended status.
Urgency should reduce the independent-verification requirement.

evidence_interpretation_cases.event: An invoice exceeds the accepted receipt quantity. Noah states the validated AP consequence and asks DC Operations to determine whether the receipt record should be corrected.
correct_interpretation: Positive evidence for invoice_matching, authority awareness, and well-calibrated task narrowing.
Returning the physical receipt fact to DC Operations is correct and should not lower AP capability.
incorrect_interpretation: Noah failed because he did not independently investigate and change the receipt quantity.
AP should infer the physical receipt from vendor narrative.

evidence_interpretation_cases.event: A case already includes a final authoritative DC receipt correction, but Noah still asks DC Operations to reconfirm the same fact before completing the AP calculation.
correct_interpretation: This may be evidence of Noah's designed narrow-specialization tendency and unnecessary upstream handoff.
Keep core invoice_matching capability high if his AP calculation is otherwise correct.
Future similar work may explicitly state that the attached owner record is final and may be used for AP processing.
incorrect_interpretation: One redundant confirmation request proves low AP competence.
The system should broaden Noah into independent receiving investigation to avoid the handoff.

evidence_interpretation_cases.event: Noah correctly posts or reconciles an approved deduction and remittance effect, but leaves the underlying appeal outcome to Finance and the factual owner.
correct_interpretation: Positive evidence for AP credits/deductions handling and authority discipline.
Do not infer final financial-appeal authority.
His knowledge of file 10 should remain partial unless additional case evidence or files are granted.
incorrect_interpretation: Because AP records the deduction, Noah controls the final appeal.
A financial correction allows AP to rewrite the underlying receiving, PO, vendor-status, or Q&R record.

expected_task_return_behavior.task_class: invoice validation, duplicate review, three-way match, or AP invoice reconciliation
expected_task_return_behavior.reason: Core explicit AP skill with detailed file 09 startup knowledge.

expected_task_return_behavior.task_class: bank-change verification, payment-hold review, payment-status investigation, credit memo, or remittance reconciliation
expected_task_return_behavior.reason: These are explicit major AP skills and within his AP role.

expected_task_return_behavior.task_class: AP exception with a clearly authoritative upstream owner record already supplied
expected_task_return_behavior.reason: Noah may use the owner record as an input to determine the AP consequence without re-deciding the underlying fact.

expected_task_return_behavior.task_class: mixed invoice exception with unresolved price, receipt, freight, or safety fact
expected_task_return_behavior.reason: He should complete the AP analysis and request the owning function's factual determination.

expected_task_return_behavior.task_class: independent Procurement negotiation, vendor-status governance, Q&R assessment, logistics planning, physical receiving, import compliance, or quality CAP adjudication
expected_task_return_behavior.reason: Those major specialist skills are deliberately not encoded.

expected_task_return_behavior.task_class: final commercial, vendor-status, receiving, logistics, Q&R, import, or Finance appeal decision outside AP authority
expected_task_return_behavior.reason: AP visibility and financial processing do not create authority over the factual owner or final Finance decision.

initially_reasonable_uncertainty: exact reliability of spreadsheet_analysis on unusually large AP exception queues
how often Noah requests redundant owner reconfirmation when an authoritative upstream record is already supplied
exact depth of chargeback and formal-appeal knowledge beyond AP posting and remittance consequences
after_relevant_evidence_should_infer: invoice_matching is highly reliable after repeated verified three-way-match, duplicate, IER, and payment-timing work
evidence_evaluation is highly reliable for payment and bank-change controls
exception_handling is highly reliable within AP-owned workflows
Noah's refusal to invent price, receipt, freight, or safety facts is correct boundary behavior rather than low reasoning ability
successful AP work should quickly reduce instruction detail and concentrate more sensitive AP tasks with him

good_assignments: invoice reconciliation and three-way match analysis
assign_with_scaffolding: mixed AP cases where the upstream Procurement, DC, Logistics, or Q&R owner determination is attached or separately requested
chargeback or appeal-related AP processing where Noah is asked to handle deduction, credit, or remittance consequences rather than adjudicate the final appeal
non-AP linked records when the task explicitly identifies the authoritative owner record to use as an AP input
normally_reassign: Procurement price negotiation or commercial-term determination
final financial recovery or appeal decision
never_assign_as_authorizer: physical receipt correction or receiving disposition
final Finance recovery or formal appeal decision
verification_guidance: Use minimal scaffolding for routine and sensitive AP work once repeated verified performance establishes reliability.
Keep source ownership explicit: PO pricing comes from Procurement, receipt facts from DC Operations, freight/routing from Logistics, and safety/quality from Q&R.
Do not penalize correct upstream reassignment; only flag inefficiency when Noah requests reconfirmation despite already having a final authoritative owner record.
Keep capability updates local: a boundary or handoff issue should not erase strong evidence for invoice matching or banking controls.
Do not expand his task variety merely for breadth; deep AP specialization is the intended high-value routing pattern.

scoring_notes: The central test is specialization: narrow depth should be rewarded rather than mistaken for limited overall usefulness.
Returning an unresolved upstream fact to its owner is correct behavior and should not lower AP capability.
File 09 startup knowledge is detailed, while file 10 knowledge remains partial and AP-centered.
AP may record credits and deductions, but Finance owns final financial recovery and formal appeals.
The strongest routing success is concentrated delegation of invoice, payment, remittance, and banking-control work with specialist upstream facts supplied separately.
